name: Conservation Crew Corpsmember (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico)
org: Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico
what_you_do: Join a paid outdoor crew. You build trails, fight invasive plants, restore land and help prevent fire danger. You work with a team in Albuquerque or Taos.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 30, per the 2027 job list. No earlier experience is needed for crew member jobs.
pay_detail: $700 per week for the 2027 Corpsmember job. Paid by stipend.
duration: Seasonal, full time (40 or more hours a week). The end date is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The 2027 Corpsmember jobs list a start date of March 18, 2027. The apply page does not give a last day to apply.
how_to_apply: Open the apply page and find the 2027 Conservation Crew Corpsmember job in Albuquerque or Taos. Then use its Apply Now link.
notes: The work is outdoors. The program page says ages 17 to 25, and the job list says 17 to 30. Ask RMYC if you are close to the top age. Some crews camp for 8 days in a row, then have 6 days off. Corpsmembers who complete a full AmeriCorps season become eligible for a scholarship award. The FAQ lists UNM College Credit as a member benefit.
